body.x: LIFEPROOF(www.lifeproof.com), a manufacturer of cases for smartphone and tablets unveiled Frē Power, the waterproof battery case for iPhone, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.LifeProof Frē case provides maximum protection against water, drops, dust, and snow. The sleek structure includes a built-in screen protector and full access to all device features and functions. Frē Power not only provides protection from the elements, but also adds an additional 2,600 mAh of battery power. The lithium ion battery doubles the iPhone 6 battery life, while smart charging technology automatically shuts the case off when the device is fully charged.Frē Power is waterproof to 6.6 feet (2 meters) for one hour, drop proof up to 6.6 feet and is totally enclosed from dirt and snow when the case and all ports are sealed. It meets military standards for shock and impact protection.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
